story: On the final stage of the Région Pays de la Loire Tour 2026, 20-year-old Antoine L'Hote soloed to victory over the last 15.5 kilometres to Le Mans, holding off a group of favorites containing race leader, Alexander Kamp, Corbin Strong and Clément Venturini. The win also handed L'Hote the overall general classification title, his first professional victory.
